results.name: Audit cannot approve a month HR has not submitted
HR (maker) cannot audit-approve
HR submits the month for audit
Once submitted the month is locked: no edit, delete or re-run
Accounts cannot pay before Audit approves
Audit must write a reason to return a sheet
Returned sheet unlocks for HR to correct
Audit (checker) approves the corrected sheet
After audit approval HR still cannot change a run
Audit cannot pay (no Accounts layer)

results.name: Accounts (payer) pays the approved month
Paid total = sheet total = bank payment sheet total
The month keeps a full trail: who submitted, returned, approved and paid
Even the Superadmin cannot edit or delete a paid salary
A paid salary cannot be put on hold afterwards
An Audit-only account cannot change an employee's salary structure
An Audit-only account cannot run payroll (it would check its own work)
An Audit-only account cannot give a loan / advance
An Accounts-only account cannot add a bonus
An auditor given "Payroll" (to see the sheet) still cannot change salary structures
An auditor given "Payroll" still cannot run payroll
An auditor given "Payroll" still cannot give a loan / advance
A run cannot be processed and paid one-by-one while its month was never submitted to Audit
Whoever submitted a month cannot also approve it
The person who prepared (submitted) a month cannot also pay it
A Superadmin can prepare, approve and pay a month alone

results.name: Payroll refuses an inactive employee (ghost-employee control)
A negative bonus is refused
Present days above working days is refused or capped
Audit can read the Payroll Activity Log
HR without the Activity Log layer cannot read it
Refused attempts are logged too ("Tried: …")
Approve and pay actions are logged with the user
Each log row has time and IP
Nobody (not even Superadmin) can delete the Activity Log through the app
A salary change is logged (who, when)
Changing an employee's salary bank account is recorded (old → new, who)
Employee master edits (designation) are recorded old → new
Granting someone more access is recorded (who gave what to whom)
Failed sign-ins are kept (login_attempts)
Nobody can approve their own request, even when an Approval Template names them
